scripts.build: electron-packager . open-iris --icon=assets/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.open-iris.app --app-version=0.1.0 --no-asar --no-prune --out=out --overwrite --ignore='^/(\.env|\.hallmark|\.agents|\.claude|docs|eval|node_modules/(\.pnpm/)?(electron|@electron)[^/]*)($|/)' && electron-fuses write --app out/open-iris-darwin-arm64/open-iris.app RunAsNode=off EnableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable=off EnableNodeCliInspectArguments=off && codesign --force --deep --sign - out/open-iris-darwin-arm64/open-iris.app
scripts.postinstall: [ "$(uname)" != Darwin ] || for k in CFBundleName CFBundleDisplayName; do plutil -replace $k -string open-iris node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist; done
scripts.test: node --test src/gesture/*.test.mjs src/main/guard.selftest.mjs src/main/desktop.selftest.mjs src/main/persona.selftest.mjs src/main/listen.selftest.mjs src/main/hooks.selftest.mjs src/main/plugin-install.selftest.mjs src/main/plugin-list.selftest.mjs src/main/live-config.selftest.mjs src/main/resume.selftest.mjs src/main/context-meter.test.mjs src/renderer/devices.test.mjs src/renderer/orb-motion.test.mjs src/renderer/plugins-view.test.mjs src/renderer/ctx-view.test.mjs src/main/input.selftest.mjs src/renderer/compose-view.test.mjs src/main/perf.test.mjs
